data.body: METHODOLOGICAL FINDING - prior_reviews UNDERCOUNTS, so the study's 'uncontaminated' runs are not. Both judges on the 62d9-9f6d pair found this independently: the BLOCK half records prior_reviews=0 and the PASS half 1, but the ticket's own first comment is headed 'DESCRIPTION SUBSTANTIALLY REWRITTEN (epic e369 plan-review passes 2-8)'. The counter reads low because review-plan fast-fails INDETERMINATE with no LLM spend while a dependency is unclosed, so those hardening rounds were recorded against the EPIC, not the ticket. Consequence: the prior-review confound is WORSE than the manifest reports, and both runs treated as clean reads (2948-48e5-BLOCK and 62d9-9f6d-BLOCK, each at 0) had epic-level hardening the counter does not show. rebar's 10 TP / 0 FP on 2948-48e5-BLOCK should NO LONGER be described as a fully uncontaminated result. Any future measurement of this confound must count epic-level passes, not per-ticket prior_reviews alone. Related, from the same run: rebar's fp:1 understates its inaccuracy roughly 5x in raw claim count - 4 indeterminate findings are refuted by the plan's own text, 3 of them faulting the plan for omitting something it states explicitly (one asks for an AC present verbatim; three ask for a paragraph the plan spends 12 lines on). METHODOLOGY bars these from the FP column because the reviewer withheld a verdict; they are surfaced as contradicted_unrated, 11 corpus-wide.
